thread.title: Apple Wireless Charger Could Ship In March: Report

author: Jon Swartz
title: Apple Wireless Charger Could Ship In March: Report
text:
It didn't gather nearly the amount of ink of iPhone X and iPhone 8 during its introduction last year, but a new Apple (AAPL) product could have as much impact.
Apple's Apple Watch Series 3. Illustration: Tiernan Ray for Barron's AirPower, a wireless charging mat that can serve up to three devices, is scheduled to ship in March, according to a report by MacOtakara . Pricing information was not given.
The mat is significant because it offers Apple customers a solution to continuously charge multiple devices—whether an iPhone, Apple Watch, or AirPods—without scrambling for chargers and outlets.
Should AirPower debut in March, it might appear alongside new devices. Apple usually plans a hardware product release that month. The latest rumor is that new iPads are in the pipeline.
Apple shares are up 1% to $174.46 in afternoon trading.
